# text-normalizer

> Normalize text for indexing with an explicit, ordered rule set: zero-width removal, control characters, Unicode NFKC, curly quotes, dashes and whitespace, idempotent Python package `trysac-text-normalizer`, import name `text_normalizer`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
